items.title: File Widerspruch against refusal of tree-felling permit
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb eines Monats nach seiner Bekanntgabe Widerspruch einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Behörde: Landkreis Musterpeene, Kreishausweg 1, 17109 Musterdemmin.
items.computation: Letter is dated/posted 19.11.2026 (Thursday) by a general authority (Untere Naturschutzbehörde, Landkreis Musterpeene), not a tax office, so the delivery-fiction day is not shifted even if it fell on a weekend/holiday. §41 Abs.2 VwVfG M-V: deemed delivered on the 4th day after posting = 19.11 + 4 days = 23.11.2026 (Monday). Under §187 Abs.1 BGB (incorporated via §31 VwVfG), the day of delivery itself is not counted; the one-month Widerspruch period (§70 VwGO) runs from 24.11.2026 and ends, per §188 Abs.2 BGB, on the day with the same number one month later: 23.12.2026 (Wednesday). This day is not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in MV, so no shift under §31 Abs.3 VwVfG/§193 BGB applies.
